column1: Local sales tax (0.25%) distributions to CVTD - by month received; Utah State Tax Commission distributions lag sales by about two months - OP rev 10/13/26

1. YTD 2026 through September: $11,172,200 cash received. The financial report shows $11,463,000 YTD because it includes the accrual for the September sales month (received in November) per the modified accrual basis.
2. Growth slowed in the third quarter of 2026 (Q1 1.7%; Q2 2.0%; Q3 1.3%).
3. Distributions include the small adjustment for prior-period corrections from the Tax Commission (under $5k in any month).
